scene: A miniature wooden ladder leans against the gnarled bonsai trunk.
picture: Pixel art flat side view. The grandfather stands on the stone terrace beside his bicycle, looking at the giant potted bonsai pine. On the left, the blue ceramic pot features a small brass spigot. At the centre, a tiny wooden ladder reaches into the twisted branches. On the right, a glowing pinecone hangs low.
shown: a slender wooden ladder resting against the thick mossy trunk at the centre
